C0604.title: SPC, SPP and MPS Typical Case: Zhu Received Administrative-Criminal Linked Treatment for a Two-Card Crime
C0604.summary: On July 28, 2025, the Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate and Ministry of Public Security jointly released typical cases on punishing assistance for information-network crimes and related offenses. Case six stated that Zhu knew a fellow villager was part of a paofen money-laundering group, yet provided two bank cards and his ID card for binding to POS machines and helped transfer incoming funds. From May 19 to 23, 2022, Zhu transferred more than RMB 43,000 in fraud proceeds and over RMB 700,000 of unclear origin, receiving more than RMB 4,100. Prosecutors issued a non-prosecution decision and public security authorities imposed administrative punishment, showing administrative-criminal linkage.
